lines.text: Your objective: understand how one treaty set the world on fire.
Learn what the Treaty of Versailles demanded of Germany.
Learn how those terms broke a nation, and left its people desperate.
Learn how that desperation carried Adolf Hitler to power.
Learn how the world watched him take land, step by step, and did nothing.
And learn how it ended — with German tanks crossing into Poland.
Do you accept the mission?
Your objective: understand the summer Britain stood alone.
Learn how three hundred thousand soldiers escaped from Dunkirk.
Learn how France surrendered — and left Britain to fight on alone.
Learn how Eagle Day began Germany's assault from the sky.
Learn how the bombers turned on the cities, and the cities burned.
And learn how the battle was won — and the invasion never came.
Do you accept the mission?
Your objective: understand how the war became the whole world's war.
Learn why Japan chose to strike America across the Pacific.
Learn what the bombers came for at Pearl Harbor — and what they missed.
And learn how America's answer changed the course of the entire war.
Do you accept the mission?
Your objective: understand the battle that turned the war around.
Learn how Germany broke its promise and invaded the Soviet Union.
Learn why the fighting came to one city on the Volga.
Learn how a city in ruins was defended, house by house.
Learn how the Red Army struck where the Germans were weakest.
And learn how an entire German army was lost, and the war changed direction.
Do you accept the mission?
Your objective: understand how the Allies fought their way back into Europe.
Learn why the Allies had to return to Western Europe at all, and what was waiting for them on that coast.
Learn how Britain became a launch pad, and how the whole invasion came down to a weather forecast.
Learn how Germany was persuaded to look the wrong way.
Learn what happened on the 6th of June, and why holding the ground mattered more than taking it.
Do you accept the mission?
